A '''plasma cannon''' was a type of weapon that fired plasma balls at enemy vehicles or [[Starship/Legends|starships]], causing massive electrical disturbances that disabled the target for a time. An example of a plasma cannon was a [[M-68 planetary magnapulse cannon]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Consortium space station]]s and [[Aggressor-class destroyer|''Aggressor''-class Star Destroyers]] used by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] were also equipped with plasma cannons.

[[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms']] [[SD-9 battle droid|S-9]] and [[SD-10 battle droid]]s were equipped with arm-mounted plasma cannons.<ref name="EGTD" />
